description: 🚀 We are a team of curious innovators passionate about AI, software development, data science, and space technology. Using NASA’s open data, we aim to build impactful solutions that make complex Earth and space information accessible and meaningful. We value creativity, collaboration, and problem-solving, and welcome developers, designers, researchers, and storytellers who are excited to learn, innovate, and create something extraordinary together. 🌎✨
summary:
**PrithviX – NASA-Powered Agricultural Intelligence Platform**

PrithviX is an agricultural intelligence platform that transforms NASA Earth observation data into actionable insights for farmers. By integrating datasets such as SMAP, GPM, ECOSTRESS, Landsat, and NASA POWER, the platform aims to monitor soil moisture, rainfall, temperature, vegetation health, and other environmental conditions specific to a farm's location.

It brings satellite-based monitoring, interactive dashboards, crop recommendations, irrigation advisories, crop rotation guidance, and agricultural alerts into one accessible platform. Its AI assistant, PrithviXAI, helps users understand farm conditions and the reasoning behind recommendations through simple, understandable explanations.

PrithviX addresses the challenge of adapting farms to changing environmental conditions by making NASA's openly available Earth science data more accessible and useful for agricultural decision-making. It is important because farmers need timely, location-specific information to manage resources, anticipate environmental stress, and make more informed farming decisions, supporting more resilient and sustainable agriculture.
details:
🌱 PrithviX – Making NASA Data Work for Farmers

Imagine a farmer who wants to know whether the soil has enough moisture, whether rainfall has been sufficient, or whether the farm is experiencing environmental stress. What if satellite data could help answer these questions?

That's the idea behind PrithviX!

PrithviX brings NASA's Earth observation data closer to farmers by turning complex satellite information into simple, farm-specific insights. Using datasets such as SMAP, GPM, ECOSTRESS, Landsat, and NASA POWER, it aims to monitor soil moisture, rainfall, temperature, and vegetation conditions.

But we don't stop at showing data! 🌍

Our platform brings together:

  • 🌧️ Soil & Climate Monitoring: Understand changing farm conditions.
  • 🌾 Crop Recommendations: Explore crops suited to available environmental information.
  • 💧 Irrigation Insights: Make more informed water-management decisions.
  • 🔔 Smart Alerts: Stay aware of important environmental changes.
  • 🤖 PrithviXAI: An AI-powered agricultural assistant designed to explain farm insights in simple language.

We developed PrithviX using React, TypeScript, Python, Google Earth Engine, Google Colab, and FastAPI, combining satellite data processing with an interactive web platform.

What makes PrithviX different is its focus on connecting multiple NASA datasets with individual farm locations and translating scientific observations into understandable guidance.

Our goal is simple: Bridge the gap between space technology and the people who work on the ground every day.

Because smarter farming decisions today can help build more resilient agriculture tomorrow. 🌱
